decisions.reason: The source requests identification of the D2D 302-page PDF but does not change its 0.68-inch spine specification.
Distinguishing the two delivered PDFs does not change the required blurb content or reflow behavior.
The source uses the existing 300-page Amazon specification to identify a PDF and does not change the Amazon page count or spine width.
The request concerns labeling or distinguishing delivered PDFs, not Amazon upload acceptance or the smaller backup PDF.
The PDF-identification request does not alter the title typography or its required matching locations.
